title: Transition from the Delhi Emperor Episode to the Episode of Emperor Karon

blocks.text: The page closes the Delhi emperor material by showing that royal anger cannot finally prevail over prophetic truth. Guru Nanak warns that the Delhi sovereignty would not endure, turning the emperor's hostility into a sign of political impermanence rather than lasting triumph.

At the same time, the text begins opening a new discussion about the so-called episode of Emperor Karon. That shift is important because the book moves from courtly confrontation into reflection on how later writers handled older traditions and disputed dialogues.
As a transition page, it therefore performs two jobs at once. It seals the Delhi warning and starts the textual argument that will dominate the next episode.
